note: Wikimedia Commons, “Petros Archiepiskopos Argous.JPG”; artist as recorded there: Νικολαος Ταρωνίτης — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons' file title is the Greek inscription of the picture itself, Πέτρος Ἀρχιεπίσκοπος Ἄργους — Peter, bishop of Argos — which is this folder's office. The calendar has one saint Peter styled of Argos, the wonderworking bishop who died about 925, so there is no namesake here.
